name: CreateBoltCoor_6Bolts_2x3
formula: =LAMBDA(spacingX,spacingY,[CenterX],[CenterY],LET(Cx, IF(ISOMITTED(CenterX), 0, CenterX), Cy, IF(ISOMITTED(CenterY), 0, CenterY), bolt_1, HSTACK(-spacingX / 2, spacingY), bolt_2, HSTACK(spacingX / 2, spacingY), bolt_3, HSTACK(-spacingX / 2, 0), bolt_4, HSTACK(spacingX / 2, 0), bolt_5, HSTACK(-spacingX / 2, -spacingY), bolt_6, HSTACK(spacingX / 2, -spacingY), {ref}TranslateCoor(VSTACK(bolt_1, bolt_2, bolt_3, bolt_4, bolt_5, bolt_6), Cx, Cy)))
comment: To create bolt coordinates (2x3 arrangement). Last Update at 2024-07-13.
